name: Provision Auth RLS
description: Installs the generic Zitadel<->Postgres identity/RLS core (auth schema: organizations/users/user_roles, JIT ensure_principal, STABLE accessors, whoami) into the app database and grants it to the PostgREST roles. Runs after 330-provision-postgres-app. Roles are assigned app-side in auth.user_roles (role-name-agnostic).
